creature_text.Text: I owe you $n. I thought that eternal peace had come for me.
The Lich King said my partner would be one of the mightiest knights ever known. I assume he was speaking of you? I'll rely upon your skills to get us through this in one piece.
Let's get going. Felguard roam the path ahead. I've kept my distance from them, but with you leading the way, we can fight through.
I'll bring down the barrier. Watch my back!
Еще и немного... все готово!
creature_text.comment: Барон Раздор to Нискарская вестница погибели

creature_text.Text: Margrave led the previous team that tried to kill Gorelix. I'm surprised he's alive! I didn't think the Legion kept prisoners.
Did you hear that? I think something's in that building up ahead. Let's investigate.
Well... if it isn't Margrave's protege, Minerva.
Finding you strung up like this is a surprise. I would have expected a more... gory... end.
Думаю, от живого всегда пользы больше, чем от мертвого. Ладно, тогда надо поторопиться.
Finally the keystone is ours! Let's head back.
We're here to slay a demon, not rescue every failure who couldn't get the job done.
I don't care! Slaying the demon is our first priority. Come, we've wasted enough time with this blathering.
Ну тупица! У тебя совсем мозги скисли? От магии Легиона очень просто уклониться.
Another damned barrier! Watch my back... we'll probably get jumped again.
Эй, мне нужна помощь! Я не привык просить дважды!
The barrier's down. Move quickly!
Good, now let's get out of here. The Lich King will be eager to hear of our success.
Нас атакуют! Уничтожить их!
Ты принадлежишь инквизиции!
Инквизиция пребудет всегда!
creature_text.comment: Страж Скверны - дозорный to Барон Раздор

creature_text.Text: Готовься предстать перед судом!
Твои кости будут валяться на дорогах Нискары!
Обратно в клетку!
Не-е-ет! Мои зелья...
New subjects! What delicious secrets will you hold?
Узнать... все... секреты...
Глупое смертное существо! Явилось прямо в мою ловушку!
Тебя ждут вечные муки!
<cough> Spare me your paltry words, Sliver. I've not taken my final breath yet!

These cursed demons are going to learn a new meaning of suffering when I get free! A beast called Zalinor carries the keystone that unlocks these bindings. Set me free and I'll help you rip the bastards apart!
Ah! That's much better!
We don't have much time! Margrave was taken to the citadel. The only things I've seen come out of that place are demons and corpses! We'll need to break in there to get him out.
What!? Don't you have any sense of duty to aid your fellow knights?
You're a cold one, Sliver. Fine! I'll help, but if we have any chance of getting Margrave out alive, we should take it.
Легион забрал мое оружие, так что будет честно, если я возьму оружие у демонов.
What's the delay? Go already!
О-о-ой!!! О-о-ой!!!
Противник на подходе! Надо перехватить!
creature_text.comment: Минерва Воронья Скорбь to Нискарская вестница погибели

creature_text.Text: Poor Margrave! The final death claimed you at last.
